title: Adding the external Postgres metadata plugin introduced FilterEngine.create_postgres_query(), which str.format()s DID-search filter keys and values from the REST API straight into raw SQL.

vulnerable_findings.explanation: The new `create_postgres_query` method builds SQL fragments by interpolating user‑controlled values (e.g., `value`, `key`) directly into the query string with `format()`. No parameter binding or proper escaping is performed, allowing crafted input to break out of the quoted context and inject arbitrary SQL.
